name: Lina
source:
Orias frequently dreams about this girl, but his amnesia prevents him from remembering anything more than her appearance and her importance.

[Spoiler] The daughter of Windal's greatest alchemist Magna, she was born with a weak immune system which drove Magna to devote his life to researching the bloodspring of life in the hope it might cure her condition. She gave Orias his name after he was created and treated him as family. Unfortunately one of Duke Bajorla's attempts to create Chimera led to her losing her life when she plunged into the incomplete bloodspring. [/Spoiler]

Due to her poor physical condition when alive, she read many books to pass the time. Some of the content appears to have given her an interesting vocabulary range.
